question: o04
q: How many people tapped on at Central station last Friday?

transcript.answer:
I can't get that number. My data sources don't include station-level Opal tap-ons. The Commute Pulse tool covers only broad areas (Sydney CBD, North Sydney, Chatswood, Macquarie Park, Strathfield, Parramatta), and it reports ratios and averages rather than daily counts. Central isn't one of the covered centres, and I can't retrieve individual days, so I can't tell you last Friday's figure.

For the exact count, Transport for NSW publishes Opal tap data as open data on the NSW Government open data portal (data.transport.nsw.gov.au). Station-level daily tap-on figures should be there, though the publication lag may mean last Friday's numbers aren't yet available.

I can still help with the broader picture. For example, I can show how Sydney CBD Friday evening tap-ons compare with midweek levels over recent months, which indicates how busy Fridays are relative to Tuesday to Thursday.
